name: Ux Audit
description: Conducts a heuristic UX evaluation using Nielsen's 10 usability heuristics, identifies violations with severity ratings, and produces a prioritized remediation list. Use when the user asks to audit a user experience, evaluate usability, review an interface for UX issues, or identify usability problems. Do NOT use for accessibility-specific audits (use accessibility-review), visual design critique (use visual-hierarchy-review), or user flow analysis (use user-flow-mapping).
